content:
I need to use the PNT+ repo for a project of mine, but I'd like it updated to a more recent version of Mathlib, so I prepared bump PRs to v4.31.0-rc2:

  • https://github.com/alerad/leancert/pull/48
  • https://github.com/AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/pull/1576

These are AI written, and I don't make particular promises about them, but at a quick look they seem reasonable.

Ideally the leancert PR would be merged first, but it's pausible to merge PNT#1576 directly if you don't mind temporarily depending on a fork on leancert.

(Note that Mathlib has actually moved on to v4.31.0, so we could bump direct to there: but I haven't done that yet.)

And now

  • PNT#1599 advances to v4.31.0 (diff relative to PNT#1576)
  • PNT#1600 (stacked on top of that) removes the upstreamed CostaPereira (diff relative to PNT#1599)
  • leancert#48 has been updated in place to bump directly to v4.31.0 too (so the dependency is on a v4.31.0 leancert, not an rc2 one).
I've updated PNT#1599 and PNT#1600 to use the new LeanCert release.
Just to confirm, would you recommend merging PNT#1600 and closing PNT#1599?
(I made them in layers in case you wanted to review them separately.)

Thanks for the updates. There are a couple of issues:

  • I see @Terence Tao has fixed Mertens in PNT#1613.
  • In PNT#1614 I've updated lakefile.toml to pin some deps to tags rather than main. I've also fixed the build for one of the Kadiri files.

Maybe those two PR's together give a good build. I'm happy for one to be merged into the other to test before merging to main because there may still be further errors we haven't got to yet. (Update: I've built locally and the combination of the two PRs succeeds).

There are also a number of unused simp argument warnings and other warnings that should be fixed once the build succeeds.
(If possible, could someone else take over my PRs and decide what to do with them? I think it's best if a project expert continues from here.)
The build is green now, so I think everything is resolved.
I've fixed most of the linter warnings in PNT#1615.
Also you should maybe update the V4.31.0 tag as it currently points at the broken version. Either point to the merge of PNT#1614 or merge PNT#1615 and point to that.
Sorry, could you clarify what needs to be updated here? All the PRs are merged, is there a lake manifest or something that needs updating?

No files need updating (apart from merging PNT#1615 to fix warnings). However there's a git tag for V4.31.0 which I think was maybe automatically added when you merged the initial bump so that points at a broken version. That tag should be updated to a more recent commit (or a V4.30.1 tag created). Otherwise downstream projects will pull a broken version if they use the tag.
OK, I think I fixed the tag (thanks, AI!).
